company_profile: Back Market is a global marketplace for refurbished devices that makes tech reliable, affordable and better for the planet.
title: Senior Data Scientist
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8+ years developing, productionizing and operating ML models and LLM applications across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Owns LLM evaluation end to end, from metrics with LLM evaluators and tracing to production rollout, and integrates Claude and OpenAI APIs into LangGraph agents. Leads client POCs and mentoring, and presents work to technical and business stakeholders. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Customer Support Troubleshooting Agent
bullets: Built an LLM troubleshooting agent for e-commerce customer support that diagnoses device issues through guided questions and tool calls, suggesting fixes before a return is opened.
Evaluated it with LLM-as-judge scoring on labelled conversations and an offline A/B comparison against scripted flows, then served it through FastAPI with tracing and MLflow.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Data Scientist role on the AI for Care team. Most of my recent data science work comes back to one question: how do you know an LLM system is actually doing its job? I have built these systems and, more importantly, the evaluations that decide whether they ship.

Back Market gives devices a second life, and helping a customer fix a phone instead of returning it is a small change with a real effect on waste. That is work I want to be part of. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Paris together and settle there long term.

At United Health Group I built evaluation and observability pipelines for Question Answering and Summary Agents that reduced human-in-the-loop review by 43%, and a LangGraph analytics chatbot that cut manual analysis by 98%. I would bring the same habit of measuring first to your troubleshooting and care agents, and share it with the wider team.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It reminds me that an AI tool is only good if the person on the other side feels helped, which is the heart of customer care. I would be glad to talk further.
